«Почему у нас до сих пор нет лекарства от рака?» — спросил меня мой пациент.

Я пожал плечами. «Есть много разных видов рака, — ответил я. — Для некоторых есть излечения, для других мы ещё учимся, как лучше их лечить».

«Я думаю, — сказал мой пациент с уверенностью, будто делится сверхсекретной теорией. — Я думаю, на самом деле существует лекарство от рака, но фармацевтические компании просто не хотят, чтобы мы о нём знали».

Я покачал головой. «Я думаю, мы делаем всё, что в наших силах, — сказал я ему. — Мы продвинулись далеко в лечении рака, но нам ещё предстоит пройти большой путь».

Рак — страшное заболевание. Один христианин сказал мне, что он не боится умирать, но если бы у него был выбор, он предпочёл бы почти любую другую причину смерти, лишь бы не умирать от рака.

Более того, это кажется чем‑то таинственным. Кажется, что болеющих становится больше, и при этом никто толком не знает почему.

В этой статье я хотел бы уделить время тому, чтобы объяснить, что такое рак, и обсудить тесты на скрининг рака. В второй части (в следующем номере), если Бог позволит, я рассмотрю некоторые из доступных методов лечения рака.

Отмечу здесь, что я — семейный врач. Я лечил многих пациентов с раком, но я, безусловно, не онколог и не знаю всего о раке. Тем, что я понимаю, я готов поделиться.

Что такое рак?

Как и во многих вещах, мы можем проследить истоки рака до падения человека в Саду Эдема. Мы знаем, что Бог сотворил человека совершенным. В первоначальном состоянии у людей не было рака и у них не было бы причин его получить.

Чтобы понять, что такое рак, нам нужно понять, как ведут себя нормальные ткани и клетки.

Нормальные клетки живут определённое время, а затем умирают. Этот процесс называется апоптозом. Он обеспечивает постоянное обновление клеток. Он также предотвращает «восстание» какого‑то одного типа клеток и их рост в месте, где им не место.

Каждый раз, когда наши клетки делятся, они копируют свою ДНК в дочерние клетки. Обычно это происходит без ошибок, но иногда при копировании возникает ошибка. Мы называем эти ошибки мутациями.

Раковые клетки — это клетки, у которых утрачены нормальные «тормоза» в поведении. Из‑за мутаций в их ДНК у них больше нет ограниченного срока жизни, и они не соблюдают границы своего места в теле. Вместо этого они начинают посягать на окружающие ткани, при этом привлекая дополнительный кровоток и питательные вещества.

Раковые клетки могут увеличиваться локально или распространяться через лимфатическую систему или кровообращение в отдалённые части тела. Когда раковые клетки оказываются в местах, отличных от места их происхождения, мы называем это метастазами.

Тип рака определяется типом клетки, которая вышла из‑под контроля и размножается. Врач не говорит просто «рак кожи», хотя существуют раки, происходящие из клеток кожи. Вместо этого эти раки классифицируют как базально‑клеточный карцином, плоскоклеточный карцином и меланому — каждый термин относится к разному типу клеток кожи. Каждый из этих видов рака кожи ведёт себя по‑разному. Базально‑клеточный и плоскоклеточный карциномы растут локально и редко дают метастазы, тогда как меланома очень склонна к распространению в другие части тела.

Кроме того, то, как рак реагирует на лечение, будет зависеть от типа клетки, из которой он возник, а не только от органа, где он локализуется.

Причины мутаций…

Мы не знаем, насколько распространён был рак до потопа. Я полагаю, что он был довольно редким.

Мы знаем, что до потопа люди жили очень долго — часто по нескольку сотен лет (вплоть до 900 лет). Мутации должны были быть редки. Их ДНК была ближе к первоначальному генетическому образцу человека (а значит и к совершенству), чем наша в XXI веке (н.э.). Следовательно, вероятность появления мутировавших и аномальных генов была значительно ниже, чем теперь.

…Факторы среды

Помимо этого, должно было произойти нечто вокруг времени потопа, что увеличило скорость мутаций. Возможно, повысился уровень радиации. Возможно, произошли генетические изменения, которые постепенно привели к появлению рака.

Рак прямо не упомянут в Библии, хотя возможно, что «язва» у Езекии могла быть каким‑то злокачественным образованием. Также возможно, что некоторые болезни, постигшие филистимлян, когда ковчег завета был у них в земле, были связаны с раковыми опухолями.

После потопа люди стали умирать в более молодом возрасте, и уже вскоре после времени Авраама редко жили значительно дольше ста лет.

Сегодня мы знаем, что факторы, повреждающие механизм копирования клетки и её ДНК, увеличивают риск рака. Самым известным из них является радиация.

После сброса атомных бомб на Хиросиму и Нагасаки у выживших отмечено значительное увеличение некоторых видов рака. Лейкемия (рак крови) была наиболее распространённым типом, за ней следовали рак желудка, лёгких, печени и молочной железы.

Большинство людей не сталкивается с радиацией на регулярной основе. Однако если вы работаете в рентгенологическом отделении или вам пришлось получать радиацию для лечения какого‑то вида рака, возможно, вы подвергались значительно более высоким уровням радиации, чем общая публика.

Существует много других факторов, связанных с ростом заболеваемости раком. Воздействие ультрафиолетового излучения увеличивает риск рака кожи и является важной причиной, по которой врачи рекомендуют кремы с солнцезащитным фактором и защитную одежду при пребывании на солнце, чтобы ограничить ультрафиолетовое воздействие.

Наконец, множество химических веществ, присутствующих в разных отраслях производства, могут повышать риск развития рака.

…Неполезные продукты питания

Продукты с высоким содержанием нитритов увеличивают риск раков кишечника. Нитриты обычно присутствуют в копчёных и вяленых мясных изделиях. Поэтому, чтобы быть здоровыми, людям следует ограничить потребление таких продуктов — либо вовсе исключить, либо свести их к очень малой доле общего рациона.

…Некоторые предшествующие заболевания

Ещё одно важное замечание: некоторые виды инфекций могут повышать риск рака. Вирус Эпштейна—Барра, вызывающий инфекционный мононуклеоз, ассоциирован с некоторыми видами лимфомы. Вирусы гепатита B и C увеличивают риск гепатоцеллюлярной карциномы (рака печени). Инфекции Helicobacter pylori в желудке связаны с раком желудка.

Важно помнить, что если кто‑то перенёс одну из этих вирусных инфекций, это не означает, что он обязательно заболеет раком. Это лишь увеличивает риск того, что заражённый человек в будущем может получить рак.

…Вредные привычки

Наконец, некоторые токсины существенно повышают вероятность рака. Очевидный пример — табакокурение, которое сильно увеличивает риск рака лёгких, горла и даже мочевого пузыря. Алкоголь — ещё один фактор риска. Алкоголь повышает риск рака рта и горла, рака желудочно‑кишечного тракта и рака печени. На самом деле нет безопасной дозы воздействия ни одного из этих токсинов, но, без сомнения, чем выше уровень воздействия, тем хуже.

Скрининг на рак

Существует множество тестов, которые утверждают, что способны скринировать различные виды рака. Большинство из них по крайней мере в какой‑то степени эффективны в выявлении рака на ранних стадиях. Однако у некоторых есть проблемы, которые указывают на то, что тест бесполезен для действительно полезного скрининга.

Хорошая отправная точка — просто представить, каким был бы идеальный скрининговый тест. Это поможет нам понять, где тесты могут быть полезны, а где нет.

Идеальный скрининговый тест имел бы ряд характеристик. Во‑первых, у него не было бы ложноположительных и ложноотрицательных результатов. Иными словами, все, у кого тест положителен, действительно имели бы рак, а те, у кого тест отрицателен, не имели бы рака. Далее, тест выявлял бы рак на такой ранней стадии, что его было бы легко лечить. Тест должен быть дешёвым и минимально инвазивным, а также требовать минимального облучения.

К сожалению, ни один из тестов, которые мы ныне используем для скрининга, полностью не соответствует этим критериям.

Во‑первых, многие тесты дают как ложноположительные, так и ложноотрицательные результаты. Это обе проблемы. С ложноотрицательным тестом всё понятно — человек думает, что у него нет рака, хотя он есть. Ложноположительный тест, напротив, приводит к повышенной тревоге, а также к затратам и рискам от последующих исследований, необходимых, чтобы пациент убедился, что рака у него нет.

Примером неудачного теста в этом отношении является CEA‑125. CEA‑125 — это вещество, которое вырабатывается некоторыми видами рака. Он используется онкологами для отслеживания ответа пациента на химиотерапию.

Казалось бы, логично использовать его как скрининговый тест, но это просто не работает. Многие люди имеют повышенные уровни CEA без наличия рака, а с другой стороны, множество ЖКТ‑раков вовсе не вырабатывают это вещество. Массовое тестирование на CEA‑125 приведёт к большему числу сканирований и биопсий, но вряд ли существенно повлияет на смертность от рака.

Ещё один вопрос связан с самим характером рака. Чтобы тест был полезен, рак должен проходить длительную прогрессию через предраковые стадии, прежде чем превратиться в полноценный рак.

Пример — рак толстой кишки. У большинства людей, у которых развивается рак толстой кишки, за несколько лет до этого появляются предраковые полипы. Именно поэтому колоноскопии могут быть эффективны в предотвращении прогрессирования в рак.

Если пациент проходит колоноскопию, врач может обнаружить полипы. Более того, он может удалить полипы через эндоскоп, что, надеемся, остановит прогрессирование в рак.

Ещё один связанный момент: должен быть какой‑то реальный эффект от раннего выявления рака. Если новый тест обнаруживает рак на шесть месяцев раньше существующих тестов, люди в среднем будут жить на шесть месяцев дольше с этим раком, даже если ничего больше не изменится.

Вопрос в том, приводит ли ранняя диагностика к более эффективному лечению. Можно ли удалить опухоль до того, как она распространится в лимфатические узлы, и тем самым полностью избежать необходимости в химиотерапии?

Если эффективность лечения и показатели ответа одинаковы независимо от стадии, на которой диагностирован рак, тогда скрининг действительно не имеет смысла.

Рабочая группа по превентивным услугам США (United States Preventive Services Task Force) — это добровольная группа экспертов, которая изучает литературу по различным тестам. На основе проведённых исследований они дают рекомендации по тем или иным тестам и по частоте их применения.

Эта панель обычно даёт более консервативные рекомендации, чем многие онкологические общества. Например, они рекомендуют раз в два года проводить маммографию у женщин в возрасте от 50 до 75 лет, тогда как другие организации рекомендуют скрининг ежегодно.

К каждой рекомендации они прилагают оценку качества исследований, которые её поддерживают, а также ссылки на эти исследования. Их рекомендации хорошо исследованы. Это полезно для людей с низким риском, которые пытаются решить, какие обследования делать. Если у человека высокий риск из‑за семейной истории или факторов воздействия, их рекомендации менее применимы.

Проблемы при борьбе с раком

Люди часто говорят о раке так, будто это единое явление. Как уже упоминалось, рак — это нечто неоднородное. Рак кожи ведёт себя иначе, чем лимфома, а та, в свою очередь, отличается от сарком. Маловероятно, что когда‑то появится единое средство от всех видов рака — та самая «таблетка от рака», о которой говорят люди.

Ещё более серьёзная сложность при борьбе с раком в том, что раковые клетки очень похожи на наши нормальные клетки. По сути, мы пытаемся отравить раковую ткань чуть сильнее, чем остальные нормальные ткани. Сейчас доступно множество различных методов лечения. Во 2‑й части мы рассмотрим некоторые доступные сегодня варианты и другие, которые могут появиться в будущем.

Заключительные мысли

При размышлении о проблеме рака на ум приходят несколько мыслей.

Нам не нужно жить в страхе или принимать решения под воздействием страха. Не бойся, ибо Я с тобою; не смущайся, ибо Я — Бог твой; Я укреплю тебя, и помогу тебе, и поддержу тебя десницею правды Моей — Исаия 41:10.

Я не думаю, что мы должны фаталистически позволять всему происходить, объясняя это тем, что это «воля Божья». Мы должны принимать мудрые решения, а затем, сделав это, не жить в состоянии постоянной тревоги.

Итак не заботьтесь о завтрашнем дне, ибо завтрашний день сам будет заботиться о своём; достаточно для каждого дня своей заботы — Матфея 6:31-34.

Наконец, если мы можем с помощью разумных решений предотвратить возникновение или распространение какого‑то вида рака, это кажется разумной целью. Никто из нас не будет жить в этом теле вечно, но если мы сможем умереть не от рака, это тоже хорошая цель. Да даст нам Бог мудрость заботиться о теле, которое Он нам дал.

In the last couple of years, something that God has been working on in my heart is the area of submission. I don’t want to look back in a wrong way, but I see where I have failed my husband in the role that God has given for me to function as his helper, one that is meet for him. As I have been thinking about my own life, I have come to realize how important our role is as Christian women, in our homes and in the lives of our children.

I realize that our children are going to need to make their own decision when it comes to being a disciple of Christ, but my desire is that I am not the reason that our children rebel against the Word of God. When we honor our husbands the way that God has taught in His Word, the example of our lives will draw the unbelieving to Christ. In the flesh, we will not be able to honor our husbands in a way that will bring glory to God, but with Christ we can do all things according to His will.

I have a burden about this because in the last couple of months I have noticed how much our homes are under constant attack from the enemy of our souls, as he tries to use our flesh and the world. As I write on this, I don’t feel that I will do justice to it, so I will just write some of my thoughts and pray that all who read this article will be encouraged in their marriages to honor, respect, and love their husbands.

  • Nevertheless let … the wife see that she reverence her husband –Ephesians 5:33.
  • Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands… –1 Peter 3:1.
  • Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are… –1 Peter 3:6.
  • Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord –Ephesians 5:22.
  • But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God –1 Corinthians 11:3.
  • Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection. But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence. For Adam was first formed, then Eve. And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression –1 Timothy 2:11-14.
  • Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be [subject] to their own husbands in every thing –Ephesians 5:24.
  • Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law –1 Corinthians 14:34.

These Scriptures are not my own, but God’s. He gives us His Word to read and to live by because that is the only way we will be able to have peace and harmony in our homes. Even more importantly, the ONLY way that we can have a clear conscience before God is when we are in the center of His will.

When we think of submission, what comes to mind? Do we think that if we submit, we will be taken advantage of? Do we think that we are wiser than our husbands? I know to the flesh this sounds kind of hard, but if we could only realize that if we don’t allow our husbands to lead out and make decisions, we are only crippling them. The reality is that if our husbands make mistakes, it is okay because we ourselves make mistakes as well. Also, if we are born again, and we are walking with God, but our husbands are not, God will still take care of us. The Scriptures teach that if our husband is not in his place, then through the wife walking according to the clear teaching that God has given her in His Word, the husband can be won through her conversation (or by the way she conducts her life).

We need to trust God with our whole lives, even in the area of our marriage. God is a God of order. Think of how God desires the children to honor the parents and the parents to not provoke their children to anger; it’s no different in the husband-and-wife relationship. The husband is to love his wife as Christ loves the church, and the wife is to reverence her husband.

In the beginning, God created male and female. He created Adam and said that it was not good for man to be alone; then He created woman from the rib of Adam’s side. God’s heart in the beginning was that man and woman would be one, and together they would walk with God and glorify Him. Then through Adam and Eve yielding to temptation, sin was brought into the world. Whenever we are struggling in our marriage, I am reminded how it was Eve that first yielded to the serpent’s temptation. Let us as wives be quick to examine our own hearts to be sure that we are in our place. When situations arise, how often are we as women tempted to think that we know better and could handle the situation better than our husbands.

God has designed our husbands to be our protector if we stay under them. I realize that we are imperfect, and that makes it more challenging to submit to our husbands. However, I believe that when we are born again by the Spirit of God, His love in us enables us to submit to our husbands. I also realize that there are a lot of broken homes. My encouragement to anyone who is in a less than ideal situation is to sincerely pray…first for yourself that you can walk in a blameless way and also for your husband that he would be what God has designed him to be—not what you think he should be. Many times, we get confused about this and it causes us to have bad thoughts about our husbands.

Titus gives us sisters clear direction from God. The aged women likewise, that they be … teachers of good things; That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children, To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed –Titus 2:3-5.

Another temptation that we women face is to compare our husbands with other men. Perhaps we tell our husbands that this other man wouldn’t do such and such the way you do, or the way he does something is better than the way you do. Maybe we don’t even say these words, but our actions can tell our husbands a lot. God’s Word teaches us to be obedient to our own husbands, and not another. Each husband is gifted in a different way, and that is why each wife is especially suited for their husband. And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help [helper, aid, supporter] meet [suitable, appropriate, complementary] for him –Genesis 2:18.

That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children –Titus 2:4. The word “love,” in to love their husbands means “to be affectionately fond of their man” as compared to the word “love” in to love their children which means “to have a maternal fondness for one’s children”. What kind of love are we showing our husbands? Can our husbands trust us that we only have their good in mind, or do we pretend to love in order to get something in return? True love will forgive in spite of failures, even when we think the pain is too great to bear. True love will cause us to pray for ourselves and our husbands when we feel differently about something than they do. True love will not cause us to despair, rather it will cause us to seek God even more.

When we are tempted to speak about our husbands’ faults to others, let us not yield to that temptation but let’s pray for them. Would we appreciate our husbands talking about our faults to other people? Also, pray for discernment to know if, and when, to speak to someone about a sin that your husband may be involved in. Let us not rail on or nag our husbands when difficulties arise. Instead, let us ask God to work in our lives and give the problem to Him and let it there. Our husbands are only too human, just as we are. If we fail at times, then we must not be surprised that they too might fail at times as well. I think what makes our marriages perfect is that we learn to forgive one another and press on to be one together.

Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation [conduct] of the wives; While they behold your chaste [modest, innocent, perfect, pure] conversation coupled with fear. Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement [terror]. Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered –1 Peter 3:1-2 & 3:6-7.

One of the first times that this verse became real to us was when our first child was around five months old. We were quite a ways from home and he started crying with a lot of pain. We prayed for him, but he still cried. We could not figure out what was wrong, so we took him into the ER. They told us that he had an ear infection and gave us medication. However, he still cried. We had a ten-hour journey home, and he cried the whole way. After we had gotten home, my husband and I discovered that there were some unresolved things between us. After we confessed our wrongs to each other and to God, we prayed again for our son. Immediately after we prayed, our son quit crying. I know not every situation turns out like this one did, but God taught us that we need to be open with each other with no hidden sin, that our prayers be not hindered.

Some questions that could be asked are: What are our children seeing in our homes? Do they see Mom reverencing their dad with joy or with fear? Do they see Mom being appropriately affectionate with her husband, such as through kind words, seeking to love the things that he loves, holding hands, etc. (I have come to realize that it is difficult to hold hands with my husband if there is something between us.) Does Mom question, challenge, or criticize what Dad does?

As our own children are growing older and into their youth years, I see how important it is that these principles are lived out in our homes. If we openly question our husband’s authority, I believe we are sowing a seed in our children that they too will question their dad’s authority. Ultimately, in the time that we live, we are seeing a generation that is questioning everything about God’s created order—there is gender confusion, evolution, and rebellion against authority in general. I have often wondered if perhaps the reason that we see so much rebellion in our plain churches is because of God’s order not being lived out in our homes.

There was a friend of ours who told us that if there would be one Christian principle that he thought would have the most impact on the home, it would be the principle of the headship order. We have a dear friend who had become a Christian before her husband. She went through a lot of difficult times, but she continued to love and reverence her husband. She fasted and prayed for many years for her husband. Today her husband will testify that it was because of his wife’s godly conduct that drew him to repentance and faith in Christ.

Another example with a different outcome… I know of a couple that didn’t have a solid marriage. The husband was not in his place and the wife became bitter, so bitter in fact, that she said that when she is buried in the grave, she doesn’t want to be buried beside her husband. This much bitterness has had a terrible effect on their children. I wondered if she had not become bitter, if she could have at least spared her children from the many heartaches that they have suffered.

I also know of another couple where both of them were badly mistreated by close family, but they chose not to become bitter. They drew closer to God and to each other through those valleys and they are reaping the benefits of the fruit of their choices to this day.

Even closer to home… I grew up in a home that was not a Christian home. Neither of my parents were born again. When they began to allow God to work in their hearts, I could see it. I would come home from gatherings and see my dad weeping as he was reading his Bible. Also, on one particular evening I came home and saw my parents sitting at the table and they were singing together. I will testify that this had a tremendous effect on my life. I could also see my own mother desiring to be in her place as God had designed her to be. When we pass from this life, what will our family say about us? Will they testify that the love of God reigned in our mortal bodies?

On a practical note, I thought I would write a few ways that we can show that we love our husbands in deed and not just in word.

  • Asking them for advice (not just going on what we think)
  • Fixing their favorite foods
  • Keeping the house orderly and neat
  • Being ready and willing to drop our plans to help our husbands with whatever they need
  • Meeting them at the door with a smile (no matter how bad of day we may have had)
  • Keeping the house quiet, even with little children, when he’s trying to rest or study
  • Teaching our children proper manners in relating to each other in the home
  • Teaching our children to love and respect their father, even if he isn’t always perfect

Another challenge I wish to give to each married sister is to think of something that you can tell your husband that you are blessed about with him, Try doing this every day for two weeks. It’s amazing what effect kindness can have on a marriage. Maybe to some this would seem like drudgery, but it’s not. I am amazed that as we get older, how much we think alike, even sometimes finishing each other’s sentences. I realize there is so much more that could have been written. I trust that God will continue to open His Word to us as we seek Him.

Editor’s Note:

I was one who struggled majorly and for years with not knowing how to submit and yet wanting to. Following is my attempt to share what God has been teaching me.

One of the main reasons that many people struggle with “submission” is that they don’t really understand what God means with the subject—they don’t understand the reality of biblical submission. Usually, a person knows what they believe on a certain subject, so in their mind when they are being asked to “submit” on that point, they think they are being asked to compromise their personal belief—or sin against their conscience.

The answer is two-fold.

First, if two people agree on an issue, then there is no need for anyone to submit. Thus, to submit does not mean that the person submitting is necessarily changing their mind, rather they are choosing to support the other person’s decision based on the fact that God says that that person is the one He is holding responsible for the decisions of that party—whether it be a couple, the home, a school, a church, etc.

Second, God knew that whenever there would be more than one person discussing a decision that needs to be made, that it would always mean that the one would end up submitting to the other. Therefore, to provide clarity in responsibility, He gives clear direction regarding whom He considers the responsible person (the spiritual authority) in each type of situation—the husband in a marriage, the father in the family, the man (the head) in the home, the ordained leaders in the church, the schoolteachers/principal in the school setting, etc. That way everyone can know who God sees as responsible for any mistakes that are made.

Consider that even though Eve took the fruit and ate it first, and then gave it to her husband to eat, God provides us with clarity regarding who He holds responsible for that failure (sin). Wherefore, as by one man [not one woman] sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned … Nevertheless death reigned from Adam [not from Eve] to Moses, even over them [Adam’s descendants—all of the human race] that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression… –Romans 5:12-14.

So, we see that God provides protection and security to all those who are under authority if they stay under that authority. The one who God clearly states as being the authority figure in each relationship will always be the one that God holds responsible for decisions made by that group of people. Just like in the fall in the Garden of Eden, sins of omission and of commission within each family will be primarily held to dad’s account. Whether dad was giving wrong direction to the family or if he was not giving direction at all, it doesn’t matter, he will still be held to account since God sees the man as being the head of his home. (see 1 Corinthians 11:3 and Romans 13:12)

पिछले कुछ वर्षों में, मेरे हृदय में परमेश्वर जो कार्य कर रहे हैं, वह आज्ञाकारिता (submission) के क्षेत्र में रहा है। मैं पीछे मुड़कर गलत तरीके से देखना नहीं चाहती, पर मैं देखती हूं कि मैंने उस भूमिका में अपने पति के प्रति कहां असफलता की है जो परमेश्वर ने मुझे उनकी सहायक के रूप में निभाने के लिए दी है—एक ऐसी जो उनके लिए उपयुक्त हो। जैसे-जैसे मैं अपने जीवन के बारे में सोच रही हूं, मुझे एहसास हुआ है कि हमारे रूप में ईसाई स्त्रियों की भूमिका हमारे घरों और अपने बच्चों के जीवन में कितनी महत्वपूर्ण है।

मुझे यह समझ है कि अपने बच्चों को मसीह के शिष्य होने का फैसला स्वयं करना होगा, पर मेरी इच्छा यह है कि हमारे कारण हमारे बच्चे परमेश्वर के वचन के विरुद्ध विद्रोह न कर लें। जब हम अपने पतियों का सम्मान उस तरीके से करेंगे जैसा परमेश्वर ने अपने वचन में सिखाया है, तो हमारे जीवन का उदाहरण अविश्वासियों को मसीह की ओर आकर्षित करेगा। शरीर की शक्ति से हम अपने पतियों का ऐसे तरीके से सम्मान नहीं कर पाएँगे कि वह परमेश्वर को महिमा दे, पर मसीह में हम उसकी इच्छा के अनुसार सब कुछ कर सकते हैं।

मुझे इस विषय के प्रति एक बोझ है क्योंकि पिछले कुछ महीनों में मैंने देखा है कि हमारे घर निरंतर हमारे आत्माओं के शत्रु द्वारा हमले के अधीन हैं, जो हमारी देह और संसार का उपयोग करने का प्रयास करता है। जब मैं इस पर लिख रही हूं, मुझे नहीं लगता कि मैं इसका न्याय कर पाऊंगी, इसलिए मैं बस अपनी कुछ सोच लिखूंगी और प्रार्थना करूंगी कि जो कोई भी इस लेख को पढ़े, वह अपने विवाह में अपने पतियों का आदर, सम्मान और प्रेम करने के लिए उत्साहित हो।

  • Nevertheless let … the wife see that she reverence her husband –Ephesians 5:33.
  • Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands… –1 Peter 3:1.
  • Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are… –1 Peter 3:6.
  • Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord –Ephesians 5:22.
  • But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God –1 Corinthians 11:3.
  • Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection. But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence. For Adam was first formed, then Eve. And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression –1 Timothy 2:11-14.
  • Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be [subject] to their own husbands in every thing –Ephesians 5:24.
  • Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law –1 Corinthians 14:34.

ये शास्त्रीय वचन मेरे नहीं, परन्तु परमेश्वर के हैं। वह हमें अपना वचन पढ़ने और उस पर जीने के लिए देता है क्योंकि यही एकमात्र तरीका है जिससे हम अपने घरों में शांति और सामंजस्य रख पाएँगे। और भी महत्वपूर्ण बात यह है कि परमेश्वर के सामने स्पष्ट अंतरात्मा तभी हो सकती है जब हम उसके इच्छानुसार केन्द्र में हों।

जब हम आज्ञाकारिता के बारे में सोचते हैं, तो क्या दिमाग में आता है? क्या हम सोचते हैं कि अगर हम आज्ञाकार्य होंगे तो हमारा फायदा उठाया जाएगा? क्या हम सोचते हैं कि हम अपने पतियों से अधिक बुद्धिमान हैं? मैं जानती हूँ कि देह के दृष्टिकोण से यह कुछ कठोर लगता है, पर यदि हम केवल यह समझ लें कि यदि हम अपने पतियों को आगे बढ़कर निर्णय लेने की अनुमति नहीं देते तो हम केवल उन्हें विकलांग कर रहे हैं। वास्तविकता यह है कि अगर हमारे पति गलतियां करते हैं, तो भी कोई बात नहीं क्योंकि हम स्वयं भी गलतियाँ करते हैं। और यदि हम नया जन्म पाए हैं और परमेश्वर के साथ चल रही हैं, पर हमारे पति नहीं हैं, तब भी परमेश्वर हमारी देखभाल करेगा। शास्त्र यह सिखाता है कि यदि हमारा पति अपनी जगह पर नहीं है, तो पत्नी के उस स्पष्ट शिक्षण के अनुसार चलने से जो परमेश्वर ने अपने वचन में उसे दिया है, पति को उसकी चाल-चर्या (या उसके जीवन के आचरण से) द्वारा जीती जा सकती है।

हमें अपने पूरे जीवन के साथ, यहां तक कि हमारे विवाह के क्षेत्र में भी, परमेश्वर पर विश्वास करना चाहिए। परमेश्वर व्यवस्था का परमेश्वर है। सोचिए कि परमेश्वर कैसे चाहता है कि बच्चे माता-पिता का सम्मान करें और माता-पिता अपने बच्चों को क्रोध के कारण उत्तेजित न करें; पति-पत्नी के संबंध में यह कोई भिन्न बात नहीं है। पति को अपनी पत्नी से वैसा प्रेम रखना चाहिए जैसा मसीह ने चर्च से प्रेम रखा, और पत्नी को अपने पति का आदर करना चाहिए।

शुरुआत में, परमेश्वर ने पुरुष और स्त्री की रचना की। उसने आदम की रचना की और कहा कि मनुष्य का अकेला होना अच्छा नहीं है; फिर उसने आदम की पसली से स्त्री बनाई। शुरू में परमेश्वर की इच्छा यह थी कि पुरुष और स्त्री एक हों, और साथ मिलकर परमेश्वर के साथ चलें और उसे महिमा दें। फिर आदम और हव्वा के लोलुपता के आगे झुकने से पाप दुनिया में आया। जब भी हम अपने विवाह में संघर्ष कर रहे होते हैं, मुझे याद आता है कि हव्वा ने सबसे पहले सर्प की प्रलोभना के आगे झुककर पाप में योगदान दिया। चलिए हम पत्नी के रूप में अपने हृदयों की शीघ्रता से जाँच करें कि क्या हम अपनी जगह में हैं। जब परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं, तो कितनी बार हम स्त्रियाँ इस प्रलोभना में रहते हैं कि हम जानते हैं और हमारे पति से बेहतर स्थिति को संभाल सकती हैं।

परमेश्वर ने हमारे पतियों को हमारे रक्षक के रूप में बनाया है यदि हम उनके अधीन रहें। मुझे एहसास है कि हम अपूर्ण हैं, और यही आज्ञाकारिता को और चुनौतिपूर्ण बनाता है। तथापि, मेरा विश्वास है कि जब हम आध्यात्मा द्वारा नवजन्म पाते हैं, तब परमेश्वर का प्रेम हमारे भीतर हमें अपने पतियों के प्रति आज्ञाकार्य करने में सक्षम बनाता है। मैं यह भी जानती हूँ कि बहुत से टूटे हुए घर हैं। मेरी प्रोत्साहना उन लोगों के लिए जो आदर्श स्थिति से कम में हैं, यह है कि ईमानदारी से प्रार्थना करें…पहले अपने लिए कि आप निर्दोष ढंग से चल सकें और साथ ही अपने पति के लिए कि वह वैसा हो जैसा परमेश्वर ने उसे बनाना चाहा है—न कि वैसा जैसा आप सोचती हैं कि उसे होना चाहिए। कई बार, हम इस बारे में भ्रमित हो जाते हैं और इससे हमारे पतियों के बारे में बुरे विचार उत्पन्न होते हैं।

तीतुस हमें बहनों के लिए परमेश्वर से स्पष्ट निर्देश देता है। The aged women likewise, that they be … teachers of good things; That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children, To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed –Titus 2:3-5.

एक और प्रलोभन जिसका सामना हम स्त्रियाँ करते हैं वह है अपने पतियों की तुलना अन्य पुरुषों से करना। शायद हम अपने पतियों से कह देती हैं कि यह दूसरा पुरुष ऐसा नहीं करता जैसा तुम करते हो, या वह जिस तरह कुछ करता है वह तुमसे बेहतर है। शायद हम ये शब्द न कहें भी, पर हमारे व्यवहार हमारे पतियों को बहुत कुछ बता सकते हैं। परमेश्वर का वचन सिखाता है कि हम अपने अपने पतियों के प्रति आज्ञाकार्य हों, किसी और के प्रति नहीं। प्रत्येक पति भिन्न प्रकार से उपहारित होता है, और इसलिए प्रत्येक पत्नी अपने पति के लिए विशेष रूप से उपयुक्त है। And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help [helper, aid, supporter] meet [suitable, appropriate, complementary] for him –Genesis 2:18.

That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children –Titus 2:4. "to love their husbands" में प्रयुक्त शब्द का अर्थ है "अपने पुरुष के प्रति स्नेहपूर्वक अनुरक्त होना," जबकि "to love their children" में प्रयुक्त "love" शब्द का अर्थ है "अपनी संतान के प्रति मातृ स्नेह रखना"। हम अपने पतियों को किस प्रकार का प्रेम दिखा रही हैं? क्या हमारे पति हम पर भरोसा कर सकते हैं कि हमारा इरादा केवल उनका भला चाहता है, या क्या हम कुछ पाने के लिए प्रेम का नाटक करते हैं? सच्चा प्रेम विफलताओं के बावजूद क्षमा करेगा, भले ही वे दर्द हमें सहन करने के लिए बहुत बड़े लगें। सच्चा प्रेम हमें अपनी और अपने पतियों के लिए प्रार्थना करने के लिए प्रेरित करेगा जब हमारी सोच उनसे भिन्न हो। सच्चा प्रेम हमें निराश नहीं करेगा, बल्कि यह हमें और अधिक परमेश्वर की खोज करने के लिए प्रेरित करेगा।

जब हमें प्रलोभन होता है कि हम अपने पतियों की कमियों के बारे में दूसरों से बात करें, तो हम उस प्रलोभन के आगे न झुकें बल्कि उनके लिए प्रार्थना करें। क्या हम चाहेंगे कि हमारे पति हमारी कमियों के बारे में दूसरों से बात करें? साथ ही, यह जानने के लिए विवेक की प्रार्थना करें कि कब और किसे किसी पाप के विषय में बोलना चाहिए जिसमें आपका पति शामिल हो सकता है। आओ हम अपने पतियों के खिलाफ चिल्लाना या चुगली न करें जब कठिनाइयाँ उत्पन्न हों। इसके बजाय, परमेश्वर से प्रार्थना करें कि वह हमारे जीवन में कार्य करे और समस्या उसे सौंप दें और वहीं छोड़ दें। हमारे पति भी उतने ही मानव हैं जितनी हम हैं। अगर हम कभी-कभी असफल होते हैं, तो हमें आश्चर्य नहीं होना चाहिए कि वे भी कभी-कभी असफल हो सकते हैं। मुझे लगता है कि हमारे विवाहित जीवन को पूर्ण बनाने वाली बात यह है कि हम एक-दूसरे को क्षमा करना सीखते हैं और एक साथ एक होने के लिए आगे बढ़ते हैं।

Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation [conduct] of the wives; While they behold your chaste [modest, innocent, perfect, pure] conversation coupled with fear. Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement [terror]. Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered –1 Peter 3:1-2 & 3:6-7.

इस श्लोक का अर्थ हमारे लिए पहली बार वास्तविक रूप से तभी स्पष्ट हुआ जब हमारा पहला बच्चा लगभग पाँच महीने का था। हम घर से काफी दूर थे और वह बहुत दर्द के साथ रोने लगा। हमने उसके लिए प्रार्थना की, पर वह अभी भी रो रहा था। हम यह समझ नहीं पाये कि क्या हुआ है, इसलिए हम उसे ER में ले गए। वहाँ बतलाया गया कि उसे कान का संक्रमण है और दवा दी गई। पर वह अभी भी रो रहा था। हमारे घर जाने में दस घंटे का सफर था, और वह पूरा रास्ता रोता रहा। जब हम घर पहुँचे, तो मेरे पति और मैंने देखा कि हमारे बीच कुछ अनसुलझे बातें थीं। जब हमने एक-दूसरे और परमेश्वर से अपनी गलतियों का स्वीकार किया और फिर अपने बेटे के लिए प्रार्थना की, तो तुरंत ही हमारा बेटा रोना बंद कर दिया। मैं नहीं कह सकती कि हर स्थिति इसी तरह समाप्त होती है, पर परमेश्वर ने हमें सिखाया कि हमें एक-दूसरे के साथ खुला होना चाहिए और कोई छिपा हुआ पाप न रखना चाहिए ताकि हमारी प्रार्थनाएँ नहीं बाधित हों।

कुछ प्रश्न जिनसे पूछा जा सकता है: हमारे बच्चे हमारे घरों में क्या देख रहे हैं? क्या वे यह देखते हैं कि माँ खुशी के साथ या भय के साथ अपने पिता का सम्मान करती है? क्या वे देखते हैं कि माँ अपने पति के साथ उपयुक्त स्नेह दिखाती है, जैसे कि मधुर बोलना, उन चीजों को प्रेम करना जो वह पसंद करता है, हाथ पकड़े रखना, आदि (मैंने महसूस किया है कि अगर हमारे बीच कुछ समस्या है तो मेरे लिए अपने पति का हाथ पकड़ना कठिन होता है)। क्या माँ यह सवाल उठाती है, चुनौती देती है, या पिता की क्रियाओं की आलोचना करती है?

जैसे-जैसे हमारे अपने बच्चे बड़े हो रहे हैं और किशोर अवस्था में प्रवेश कर रहे हैं, मैं देखती हूं कि इन सिद्धांतों का हमारे घरों में जीना कितना महत्वपूर्ण है। यदि हम खुलेआम अपने पति के अधिकार पर प्रश्न उठाती हैं, तो मेरा मानना है कि हम अपने बच्चों में भी एक बीज बो रही हैं कि वे भी अपने पिता के अधिकार पर प्रश्न उठाएँगे। अंततः, जिस समय में हम रहते हैं, हम एक ऐसी पीढ़ी देख रहे हैं जो परमेश्वर के सृष्टिकृत क्रम के बारे में हर चीज़ पर प्रश्न उठा रही है—लिंग से सम्बंधित भ्रम, विकासवाद, और सामान्यतः अधिकार के विरुद्ध विद्रोह। मैंने अक्सर सोचा है कि शायद हमारे सादा (plain) चर्चों में इतना विद्रोह इसलिए दिखाई देता है क्योंकि हमारे घरों में परमेश्वर की व्यवस्था का पालन नहीं किया जाता।

हमारे एक मित्र ने हमें बताया कि यदि कोई एक ईसाई सिद्धांत हो जो घर पर सबसे अधिक प्रभाव डाल सकता है, तो वह होगा प्रभुता (headship) की व्यवस्था का सिद्धांत। हमारी एक प्रिये मित्र थी जो अपने पति से पहले ईसाई बनी थी। उसने बहुत कठिनाइयों से गुज़रना पड़ा, पर उसने अपने पति से प्रेम और सम्मान बनाए रखा। उसने कई वर्षों तक उपवास और प्रार्थना की अपने पति के लिए। आज उसका पति गवाही देता है कि उसके विश्वास और पश्चात्ताप की ओर खींचने का कारण उसकी पत्नी का भक्ति-पूर्ण आचरण ही था।

एक और उदाहरण जिसका परिणाम भिन्न था… मैं एक ऐसे जोड़े को जानती हूं जिनका विवाह मज़बूत नहीं था। पति अपनी जगह पर नहीं था और पत्नी कड़वी हो गई, इतनी कड़वी कि उसने कहा कि जब उसे दफनाया जाएगा तो वह अपने पति के पास दफन नहीं होना चाहती। इस कड़वाहट ने उनके बच्चों पर भयानक प्रभाव डाला है। मैं सोचती थी कि यदि वह इतनी कड़वी नहीं हुई होती, तो क्या उसने कम से कम अपने बच्चों को उन कई मन-भेदों से बचाया नहीं होता जो उन्होंने झेले हैं।

मैं एक और दंपती को भी जानती हूं जिन दोनों को अपने निकट परिवार द्वारा बुरा व्यवहार हुआ था, पर उन्होंने कड़वाहट न अपनाने का चुनाव किया। वे उन घाटियों के माध्यम से परमेश्वर और एक-दूसरे के और भी करीब आ गए और आज तक अपने उन चुनावों के फल काट रहे हैं।

और भी नज़दीकी—मैं ऐसे घर में बड़ी हुई जहाँ ईसाई घर नहीं था। मेरे माता-पिता में से कोई भी नया जन्मा हुआ ईसाई नहीं था। जब उन्होंने अपने हृदयों में परमेश्वर को कार्य करने की अनुमति दी, मैंने वह देखा। मैं सभा से लौटकर देखती थी कि मेरा पिता बाइबल पढ़ते समय रो रहे होते थे। एक विशेष शाम मैं घर लौटी और देखा कि मेरे माता-पिता मेज़ पर बैठे गा रहे थे। मैं गवाही दूँगी कि इसने मेरे जीवन पर बहुत बड़ा प्रभाव डाला। मैं यह भी देख सकती थी कि मेरी माँ ने अपना स्थान वह चाहती थी जैसा परमेश्वर ने उसे डिजाइन किया था। जब हम इस जीवन से गुजरेंगे, तो हमारा परिवार हमारे बारे में क्या कहेगा? क्या वे गवाही देंगे कि परमेश्वर का प्रेम हमारे नश्वर शरीरों में शासन करता था?

व्यवहारिक रूप से, मैंने कुछ तरीके लिखने का सोचा है जिनसे हम यह दिखा सकें कि हम अपने पतियों से शब्दों में नहीं बल्कि कृत्यों में प्रेम करते हैं।

  • उन्हें सलाह के लिए पूछना (सिर्फ़ अपनी सोच पर चलने के बजाय)
  • उनका पसंदीदा भोजन बनाना
  • घर को सुव्यवस्थित और साफ रखना
  • अपनी योजनाओं को त्यागकर उनकी आवश्यकताओं में उनकी सहायता करने के लिए तैयार और इच्छुक होना
  • दरवाजे पर मुस्कान के साथ उनका स्वागत करना (चाहे हमारे दिन कितना भी खराब रहा हो)
  • जब वह विश्राम या अध्ययन कर रहे हों तो घर को शांत रखना, यहां तक कि छोटे बच्चों के साथ भी
  • अपने बच्चों को घर में एक-दूसरे के साथ उचित शिष्टाचार सिखाना
  • अपने बच्चों को पिता से प्रेम और सम्मान करना सिखाना, भले ही वह हमेशा पूर्ण न हो

हर विवाहित बहन के लिए मैं एक और चुनौती देना चाहती हूं: अपने पति से हर दिन किसी ऐसी बात के बारे में कहें जिसके कारण आप उसके साथ धन्य महसूस करती हैं—दो हफ्तों तक ऐसा करने का प्रयास करें। दया का विवाह पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ सकता है यह आश्चर्यजनक है। शायद कुछ लोगों को यह श्रम जैसा लगे, पर ऐसा नहीं है। मैं आश्चर्यचकित हूं कि जैसे-जैसे हम बड़े होते हैं, हम कितनी बार एक जैसा सोचते हैं, कभी-कभी एक-दूसरे के वाक्य पूरा करते हैं। मुझे एहसास है कि बहुत कुछ और लिखा जा सकता था। मैं विश्वस्त हूँ कि जब हम उसकी खोज करेंगे तो परमेश्वर हमें अपना वचन खोलना जारी रखेगा।

Editor’s Note:

मैं एक ऐसी थी जो वर्षों तक और बड़े स्तर पर आज्ञाकारिता नहीं जान पाने में संघर्ष करती रही और फिर भी चाहती थी कि जानना। निम्नलिखित मेरे द्वारा साझा करने का प्रयास है कि परमेश्वर मुझे क्या सिखा रहा है।

कई लोगों के लिए “submission” का संघर्ष मुख्यतः इसलिए होता है क्योंकि वे वास्तव में यह नहीं समझते कि परमेश्वर इससे क्या मतलब रखता है—वे बाइबlical आज्ञाकारिता की वास्तविकता को नहीं समझते। सामान्यतः, जब कोई व्यक्ति किसी विषय पर जानता है कि वह क्या मानता है, तो जब उनसे उस बिंदु पर “आज्ञाकार्य” करने को कहा जाता है, तो वे सोचते हैं कि उनसे उनके व्यक्तिगत विश्वास के साथ समझौता करने को कहा जा रहा है—या उनके अंतर्मन-अवेदना (conscience) के विरुद्ध पाप करने को कहा जा रहा है।

उत्तर द्वि-आयामी है।

पहला, यदि दो लोग किसी मुद्दे पर सहमत होते हैं, तो किसी को भी आज्ञाकार्य करने की आवश्यकता नहीं रहती। अतः आज्ञाकार्य करने का अर्थ यह नहीं है कि आज्ञाकार्य करने वाला व्यक्ति अनिवार्य रूप से अपना मन बदल रहा है, बल्कि वे दूसरे व्यक्ति के निर्णय का समर्थन करने का चयन कर रहे हैं इस तथ्य के आधार पर कि परमेश्वर कहता है कि वह व्यक्ति उस पक्ष के निर्णयों के लिए उत्तरदायी है—चाहे वह दम्पति हो, घर हो, स्कूल हो, चर्च हो, आदि।

दूसरा, परमेश्वर जानता था कि जब भी एक से अधिक लोग किसी निर्णय पर चर्चा करेंगे, तो हमेशा होगा कि एक को दूसरे के समक्ष झुकना पड़ेगा। इसलिए, जिम्मेदारी में स्पष्टता प्रदान करने के लिए, वह हर प्रकार की स्थिति में किसे वह उत्तरदायी (आधिकारिक आध्यात्मिक प्राधिकारी) मानता है इस बारे में स्पष्ट निर्देश देता है—विवाह में पति, परिवार में पिता, घर में पुरुष (सिर/head), चर्च में मनोनीत नेता, स्कूल के संदर्भ में शिक्षकों/प्रधानाध्यापक आदि। इस तरह प्रत्येक व्यक्ति जान सके कि परमेश्वर किसे किसी भी समूह द्वारा किए गए निर्णयों के लिए उत्तरदायी मानता है।

सोचिए कि भले ही हव्वा ने पहले फल लिया और खाया, और फिर उसने अपने पति को भी दिया, पर परमेश्वर हमें यह स्पष्टता प्रदान करता है कि वह किस विफलता (पाप) के लिए किसे उत्तरदायी ठहराता है। Wherefore, as by one man [not one woman] sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned … Nevertheless death reigned from Adam [not from Eve] to Moses, even over them [Adam’s descendants—all of the human race] that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression… –Romans 5:12-14.

तो, हम देखते हैं कि यदि वे अधिकार के अंतर्गत बने रहते हैं तो परमेश्वर उन सभी को सुरक्षा और सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है जो किसी आधिकार के अधीन हैं। प्रत्येक संबंध में जिसके लिए परमेश्वर स्पष्ट रूप से उस व्यक्ति को आधिकारिक मानता है, वही व्यक्ति उन लोगों द्वारा किए गए निर्णयों के लिए परमेश्वर के समक्ष मुख्यतः उत्तरदायी होगा। ठीक वैसे ही जैसे प्राचीन उद्यान में पतन में, प्रत्येक परिवार के भीतर चूक और कमी के पापों का मुख्यतः पिता के खाते में रखा जाएगा। चाहे पिता परिवार को गलत दिशा दे रहा हो या वह बिल्कुल दिशा न दे रहा हो, इससे कोई फ़र्क़ नहीं पड़ता—परमेश्वर मनुष्य को अपने घर का सिर मानता है, इसलिए उसे उत्तरदायी ठहराया जाएगा। (देखें 1 Corinthians 11:3 और Romans 13:12)

“Why don’t we have a cure for cancer yet?” My patient asked me.

I shrugged. “There are lots of different kinds of cancer,” I said. “For some, there are cures, while for others we are still learning how best to treat them.”

“I think,” my patient said with the confidence that he was supposedly sharing a top-secret theory. “I think there actually is a cure for cancer, but the drug companies just don’t want us to know about it.”

I shook my head. “I think we are doing the best we can,” I told him. “We’ve come a long way when it comes to treatment of cancer, but we still have a long way to go.”

Cancer is a scary illness. One Christian man told me that he wasn’t afraid of dying, but if he had a choice, he would choose almost any other way to go than to die of cancer.

More than that, it is something that seems mysterious. More people seem to be getting it, yet no one really knows why.

In this article, I would like to take some time to explore what cancer is, and to discuss cancer screening tests. In the second part (in the next issue) Lord willing, I will discuss some of the treatments available for cancers.

I will mention here that I am a family doctor. I have cared for many patients with cancer, but I am certainly not an oncologist, nor do I know everything about cancer. What I understand, I am willing to share.

What is Cancer?

As with many things, we can trace the beginnings of cancer back to the fall of man in the Garden of Eden. We know that God created humans perfectly. As originally created, not only did they not have cancer, but they also would not have gotten it either.

In order to understand what cancer is, we need to understand how normal tissue and cells behave.

Normal cells live for a period of time and then die. This process is called apoptosis. It makes certain that there is a constant turnover of cells. It also prevents one type of cell from getting “out of line” and beginning to grow in a place where it doesn’t belong.

Every time our cells divide, they copy their DNA into the daughter cells. Usually this happens without error, but occasionally there is an error in the copy process. We call these errors mutations.

Cancer cells are cells that have lost the normal brakes on their behavior. Because of mutations in their DNA, they no longer have a limited life span, nor do they observe the limits of where they belong within the body. Instead, they begin to encroach on surrounding tissues, pulling in additional blood supply and nutrients in the process.

Cancer cells can enlarge locally, or they can spread through the lymphatic system or circulatory system to distant parts of the body. When cancer cells end up in other locations than where they originated, we call it metastases.

The type of cancer is determined by the type of cell that is multiplying out of control. Doctors don’t generally talk about “skin cancer,” even though there are cancers that originate in skin cells. Instead, they classify these cancers into basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and melanoma—each one referring to a different kind of skin cell. Each one of these skin cancers acts differently. Basal cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma get bigger in a local area and seldom spread elsewhere, while melanoma is very prone to spreading to other parts of the body.

Additionally, how a cancer responds to treatment is going to be based on the type of cell that it comes from, not simply the organ where it originates.

Causes of Mutations…

We do not know how common cancer was in the days before the flood. I would speculate that it was fairly rare.

We know that before the flood, men lived to be very old—often into their 900s. Mutations must have been rare. Their DNA was closer to the original genetic specimen of mankind (and thus, to perfection) than ours is in the 21st century (AD) Therefore, the chance of genes mutating and abnormal genes popping up was much less than it is now.

…Environmental Factors

Beyond that, something must have happened around the time of the flood that increased the rate of mutations. Perhaps there was an increase in radiation levels. Maybe there were genetic changes that gradually caused cancer to show up.

Cancer is not mentioned in the Bible, although it is possible that Hezekiah’s “boil” could have been some kind of cancerous growth. It is also possible that some of the diseases that affected the Philistines when the ark of the covenant was in their land were cancerous tumors.

People began dying at younger ages after the flood and by soon after the time of Abraham, they were seldom living much past their one hundredth year.

Today, we know that things which damage a cell’s copying mechanism and its DNA increase the risk of cancer. The most well-known of these is radiation.

After the atomic bombs were dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, survivors were noted to have significant increases in certain kinds of cancer. Leukemia (cancer of the blood) was the most common type of cancer, followed by cancer of stomach, lung, liver, and breast.

Radiation isn’t something that most people deal with on a regular basis. However, if you work in an x-ray department or if you needed to have radiation to treat some type of cancer, it is possible that you have been exposed to much higher levels of radiation than the general public.

There are plenty of other things that are associated with increases in cancers. Exposure to ultraviolet light increases the risk of skin cancer and is a big reason why doctors recommend sunscreen and protective clothing while enjoying the sunshine to limit ultraviolet exposure.

Finally, there are plenty of chemicals that are present in different types of work that can increase the risk of cancer.

…Unhealthy Foods

Foods that are high in nitrites increase the risk of intestinal cancers. Nitrites are typically present in smoked and cured meats. So, to be healthy, people should limit their intake of these foods to none or at the very least, a very limited percentage of the overall diet.

…Certain Prior Diseases

Another thing to mention is that certain types of infections can increase the risk of cancer. Epstein Barr virus, which causes infectious mononucleosis, has been associated with certain kinds of lymphoma. Hepatitis B and C increase the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer). And Helicobacter pylori infections in the stomach are associated with stomach cancers.

It is important to remember that just because someone has had one of these viruses it will not necessarily cause them to get cancer from that infection. Rather, it simply increases the risk that the person infected will get cancer at some point in the future.

…Unhealthy Habits

One last thing to mention is that certain toxins dramatically increase the risk of cancer. An obvious one is tobacco use, which strongly increases the risk of lung cancer, throat cancer, and even bladder cancer. Alcohol is another risk factor. Alcohol increases the risk of mouth and throat cancers, gastrointestinal cancers, and liver cancer. There really isn’t a safe amount of exposure to either of these toxic agents, but certainly the higher the level of exposure, the worse it is.

Screening for Cancer

There are many tests available that claim to be able to screen for a variety of cancers. Most of them are at least a little effective at identifying cancers at an early stage. However, there are a few problems with some of them which indicate that a certain test is ineffective at truly helping with the screening process.

A good place to start is to simply think about what a perfect screening test would look like. This will help us to see where tests might be beneficial or not.

A perfect screening test is going to have a number of features. First, it will have no false positive or false negative results. In other words, everyone who tests positive with the test will have cancer and those who test negative will not have cancer. Next, the test will identify the cancer at a point early enough in its development that it is easy to treat. The test will be cheap and minimally invasive, and it will require minimal exposure to radiation.

Unfortunately, no test that we currently do for screening totally meets these criteria.

For one thing, many tests produce both false positive and negative tests. These are both problems. The issue with a false negative test is obvious—it leads to someone thinking they don’t have cancer when they really do. A false positive test on the other hand leads to higher anxiety levels along with the cost and dangers from whatever ongoing testing is necessary to let a patient know that they don’t really have cancer.

An example of a bad test, in this respect, is the CEA-125. CEA-125 is a chemical that is made by some types of cancer. Oncologists use this level to track a patient’s response to chemotherapy.

It would make sense that you could use this as a screening test for these cancers, but it simply doesn’t work. Many people have elevated CEA levels, even though they don’t have cancer and on the other side, plenty of GI (gastrointestinal) cancers don’t make this chemical at all. Testing lots of people with CEA-125 testing will lead to more scans and biopsies, but it is doubtful if it would have a significant impact on death rates from cancer.

Another issue has to do with a particular cancer itself. In order for a test to be helpful, the cancer needs to have a long progression through precancerous stages until finally it develops into full-blown cancer.

An example is colon cancer. Most people who develop colon cancer have precancerous polyps several years before they get the cancer. This is why colonoscopies can be effective at preventing the progression to colon cancer.

If a patient has a colonoscopy, the doctor can detect the presence of polyps. More than that, he can remove the polyps through the scope, hopefully stopping the progression to cancer.

One last, related point is that there needs to be some benefit to early detection of cancer. If a new test can detect cancer six months earlier than existing tests, people will live an average of six months longer with the cancer than before, even if nothing else changes.

The question is whether diagnosing the cancer earlier leads to more effective treatment. Can you take it out before it spreads to the lymph glands and thereby completely avoid the need for chemotherapy?

If treatment and response rates are the same regardless of the stage at which you diagnose a cancer, then screening doesn’t really make sense.

The United States Preventive Services Task Force is a volunteer panel of experts that have reviewed the literature on a variety of tests. Based on the studies that have been conducted regarding the available tests, they make recommendations about the various tests and how often to use them.

This panel tends to be more conservative in their recommendations than many cancer societies. For instance, they recommend every other year for the use of mammograms for women between the ages of 50 and 75, as compared to the yearly screening recommended by other groups.

With each recommendation they give a grade of how good the studies are which support that specific recommendation, along with links for those studies. Their recommendations are well researched. This is helpful for low-risk people trying to decide what testing to do. If someone has a high risk because of family history or exposures, their recommendations are less helpful.

Cancer Challenges

People often discuss cancer as though it was a single entity. As before mentioned, cancer is not just one thing. Skin cancer behaves differently from lymphoma, which in turn behaves differently from sarcomas. The chance that there will ever be a single treatment for all cancer—the “Cure for Cancer” which people talk about, is unlikely.

An even bigger challenge when dealing with cancer cells is that they are very similar to our normal cells. Basically, we are trying to poison the cancer just a little more than the rest of our normal tissues. There are a number of different treatments that are currently available. In Part 2, we will address some of the different options available today and some others that may become available in the future.

Final Thoughts

There are a few things that come to mind when contemplating the subject of cancer.

We do not need to live in fear or make choices out of fear. Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness –Isaiah 41:10.

I don’t think that we should fatalistically allow anything to happen that might, simply because it is “God’s will.” We need to make wise choices, then having done so, we should not live in a state of anxiety.

Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed? (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things. But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you. Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof –Matthew 6:31-34.

Finally, if we can, through wise decisions, prevent a certain cancer from forming or spreading, that seems like a reasonable goal. None of us will live forever in this body, but if we can die of something other than cancer, that seems like a good goal too. May God give us wisdom to care for the body which He has given us.

“Kwanini hatujapata tiba ya saratani hadi sasa?” Mgonjwa wangu aliniuliza.

Nikashangaa. “Kuna aina nyingi tofauti za saratani,” nikamwambia. “Kwa baadhi, kuna tiba, wakati kwa nyingine bado tunajifunza jinsi ya kuzitibu kwa ufanisi zaidi.”

“Nadhani,” mgonjwa wangu alisema kwa uhakika kwamba alikuwa anashiriki nadharia ya siri kuu. “Nadhani kwa kweli kuna tiba ya saratani, lakini makampuni ya dawa hawataki tuwe nayo habari.”

Nikakubali kwa kichwa. “Nadhani tunafanya kile tulichoweza,” nikamwambia. “Tumepiga hatua kubwa katika matibabu ya saratani, lakini bado tunaelekea mbali.”

Saratani ni ugonjwa wa kutisha. Mwanaume mmoja Mkristo aliniambia kwamba hakuwa na hofu ya kufa, lakini kama angekuwa na chaguo, angechagua karibu njia yoyote isipokuwa kufa kwa saratani.

Pia, ni jambo ambalo linaonekana kuwa la fumbo. Watu zaidi wanaonekana kuipata, lakini hakuna anayejua kwa hakika kwa nini.

Nitataja hapa kwamba mimi ni daktari wa familia. Nimewatunza wagonjwa wengi wenye saratani, lakini hakika mimi si mtaalamu wa saratani (onkolojisti), wala sijui kila kitu kuhusu saratani. Ninachokielewa, niko tayari kushiriki.

Nini Ni Saratani?

Kama ilivyo kwa mambo mengi, tunaweza kufuatilia Mwanzo wa saratani nyuma kwa kuanguka kwa mwanadamu katika Bustani ya Edeni. Tunajua kwamba Mungu aliumba wanadamu wakiwa wakiwa kamilifu. Walivyoundwa asilia, sio tu hawakuwa na saratani, bali pia wangekosa kupata saratani.

Ili kuelewa ni nini saratani, tunahitaji kuelewa jinsi tishu na seli za kawaida zinavyofanya kazi.

Seli za kawaida huishi kwa kipindi fulani kisha zifa. Mchakato huu unaitwa apoptosis. Hufanya uhakika kwamba kuna mzunguko wa seli unaoendelea. Pia huzuia aina moja ya seli isije “kutoka mstari” na kuanza kukua mahali ambapo haipaswi kuwa.

Kila wakati seli zetu zinapozaa, zinakopa DNA yao hadi kwa seli bintiye. Kwa kawaida hili hufanyika bila kosa, lakini mara kwa mara kuna kosa katika mchakato wa kunakili. Tunaita makosa haya mabadiliko ya jeni (mutations).

Seli za saratani ni seli ambazo zimepoteza breki za kawaida kwenye tabia yao. Kwa sababu ya mabadiliko katika DNA yao, hawawezi tena kuishi kwa muda uliokadiriwa, wala hawaangalii mipaka ya sehemu wanapopaswa kuwa mwilini. Badala yake, huanza kuingiza tishu zinazozunguka, zikivuta damu na virutubisho vya ziada katika mchakato.

Seli za saratani zinaweza kukua kwa eneo fulani, au zinaweza kusambaa kupitia mfumo wa limfu au mfumo wa damu hadi sehemu za mbali za mwili. Wakati seli za saratani zinafika katika maeneo tofauti na yale zilipotokea kwanza, tunaita hilo masasisho ya metastasis.

Aina ya saratani inaamuliwa na aina ya seli inayozalisha bila kudhibitiwa. Madaktari kwa ujumla hawazungumzii “saratani ya ngozi” kwa jumla, ingawa kuna saratani zinazotokana na seli za ngozi. Badala yake, wanapanga saratani hizi kuwa carcinoma ya seli za msingi (basal cell carcinoma), carcinoma ya seli za squamous (squamous cell carcinoma), na melanoma—kila moja ikirejelea aina tofauti ya seli ya ngozi. Kila moja ya saratani hizi za ngozi inatenda tofauti. Basal cell carcinoma na squamous cell carcinoma hukua kwa eneo moja na mara chache kusambaa, wakati melanoma ina uwezekano mkubwa wa kusambaa sehemu nyingine za mwili.

Zaidi ya hayo, jinsi saratani inavyotenda kwa tiba itategemea aina ya seli ilikotoka, sio tu kiungo ambacho ilianza.

Sababu za Mabadiliko ya Jeni…

Hatujui ni mara ngapi saratani ilikuwa kabla ya mawimbi ya maji (kuwasubiri). Ningetabiri kwamba ilikuwa nadra sana.

Tunajua kwamba kabla ya mawimbi ya maji, watu waliishi miaka mingi—mara nyingi hadi mamia za miaka (zaidi ya 900). Mabadiliko ya jeni yalipaswa kuwa nadra. DNA yao ilikuwa karibu zaidi na sampuli ya asili ya jenetiki ya binadamu (na hivyo, karibu na ukamilifu) kuliko ya sisi katika karne ya 21 (AD). Kwa hivyo, nafasi ya jeni kubadilika na kuibuka kwa vijenetiki visivyo vya kawaida ilikuwa ndogo kuliko ilivyo sasa.

…Vitu vya Mazingira

Zaidi ya hayo, kitu fulani kilitokea karibu na wakati wa mawimbi ya maji kiliongeza kiwango cha mabadiliko ya jeni. Labda kulikuwa na kuongezeka kwa viwango vya mionzi. Labda kulikuwa na mabadiliko ya kijeni yaliyotokea polepole yaliyofanya saratani kuanza kuonekana.

Saratani haikutajwa katika Biblia, ingawa kuna uwezekano kwamba “uvimbe” wa Hizkia ulikuwa aina ya ukuaji wa kansa. Pia kuna uwezekano kwamba baadhi ya magonjwa yaliyowagonga Wafilisti wakati sanduku la agano lilipopatikana katika nchi yao yalikuwa uvimbe wa kansa.

Watu walianza kufa wakiwa wahanga wa umri mdogo baada ya mawimbi ya maji na hivi karibuni baada ya wakati wa Abrahama, mara chache waliishi zaidi ya miaka mia moja.

Leo, tunajua kwamba vitu vinavyoharibu mashine ya kunakili ya seli na DNA yake vinaongeza hatari ya saratani. Kinachojulikana zaidi kati ya hivi ni mionzi (radiation).

Baada ya mabomu ya atomiki kutolewa Hiroshima na Nagasaki, waliopona walionekana kuwa na kuongezeka kwa baadhi ya aina za saratani. Leukemia (saratani ya damu) ilikuwa aina ya kawaida zaidi, ikifuatiwa na saratani ya tumbo, mapafu, ini, na matiti.

Mionzi si jambo ambalo watu wengi wanakutana nalo kila siku. Hata hivyo, ikiwa unafanya kazi katika idara ya x-ray au ikiwa ulitakiwa kupokea mionzi kutibu aina fulani ya saratani, inawezekana umeonyesha viwango vya juu vya mionzi kuliko umma kwa ujumla.

Kuna vitu vingine vingi vinavyohusishwa na kuongezeka kwa saratani. Kufichuliwa kwa mwanga wa ultraviolet kunaongeza hatari ya saratani ya ngozi na ndiyo sababu kuu kwa madaktari kupendekeza krimu za jua (sunscreen) na nguo za kinga wakati wa kufurahia jua ili kupunguza mfiduo wa ultraviolet.

Mwisho, kuna kemikali nyingi zilizopo katika aina mbalimbali za kazi ambazo zinaweza kuongeza hatari ya saratani.

…Vyakula visivyo vya Afya

Vyakula vyenye nitriti nyingi vinaongeza hatari ya saratani za utumbo. Nitriti kawaida hupatikana katika nyama iliyochomwa na kusagwa. Kwa hivyo, ili kuwa na afya, watu wanapaswa kupunguza ulaji wa vyakula hivi hadi sifuri au angalau, sehemu ndogo sana ya mlo mzima.

…Magonjwa ya Awali

Jambo jingine la kutaja ni kwamba aina fulani za maambukizi zinaweza kuongeza hatari ya saratani. Virusi vya Epstein Barr, vinavyosababisha mononucleosis ya kuambukiza, vimehusishwa na aina fulani za lymphoma. Hepatitis B na C zinaongeza hatari ya hepatocellular carcinoma (saratani ya ini). Na maambukizi ya Helicobacter pylori katika tumbo yanahusishwa na saratani za tumbo.

Ni muhimu kukumbuka kwamba kwa sababu mtu ameambukizwa moja ya virusi hivi haimaanishi kwamba bila shaka atapata saratani kutokana na maambukizi hayo. Badala yake, inaboresha tu hatari kwamba mtu aliyeambukizwa atapata saratani katika muda fulani wa maisha yake.

…Tabia zisizo za Afya

Jambo la mwisho kutaja ni kwamba sumu fulani huongeza kwa kiasi kikubwa hatari ya saratani. Mfano wazi ni matumizi ya tumbaku, ambayo huongeza sana hatari ya saratani ya mapafu, saratani ya koo, na hata saratani ya kibofu. Pombe ni hatari nyingine. Pombe huongeza hatari ya saratani ya mdomo na koo, saratani za mfumo wa mmeng'enyo wa chakula, na saratani ya ini. Hakuna kiasi salama cha mfiduo kwa mojawapo ya sumu hizi, lakini hakika kadri kiwango cha mfiduo kinavyoongezeka, ndivyo mbaya zaidi.

Uchunguzi wa Saratani

Kuna vipimo vingi vinavyodaiwa kuwa vinavyoweza kuchunguza aina mbalimbali za saratani. Kiwango kikubwa cha vipimo hivi vinafaa kidogo kupatikana saratani katika hatua za mwanzo. Hata hivyo, kuna matatizo kadhaa kwa baadhi yao ambayo yanaonyesha kwamba kipimo fulani hakifanyi kazi vizuri kusaidia mchakato wa uchunguzi.

Mahali pazuri pa kuanza ni kufikiria tu jinsi ambavyo kipimo kamili cha uchunguzi kingeonekana. Hii itatusaidia kuona wapi vipimo vinaweza kuwa vya faida au la.

Kipimo kamili cha uchunguzi kitakuwa na sifa kadhaa. Kwanza, hakitakuwa na matokeo ya uwongo chanya au uwongo hasi. Kwa maneno mengine, kila mtu atakayepatwa chanya na kipimo ataweza kuwa na saratani na wale watakaopata hasi hawata kuwa na saratani. Pili, kipimo kitaweza kutambua saratani katika hatua ya kutosha mapema kwa maendeleo yake kwamba ni rahisi kuitibu. Kipimo kitakuwa bei nafuu na kisichovunja mwili, na kitahitaji mfiduo mdogo wa mionzi.

Kwa bahati mbaya, hakuna kipimo tunachofanya sasa kwa uchunguzi kinachokidhi kabisa vigezo hivi.

Kwanza, vipimo vingi hutoa matokeo ya uwongo chanya na uwongo hasi. Hizi zote ni matatizo. Tatizo la kipimo uwongo hasi ni dhahiri—linasababisha mtu kufikiri hana saratani wakati kwa kweli ana. Kipimo uwongo chanya kwa upande mwingine linaleta wasiwasi wa juu pamoja na gharama na hatari zinazotokana na uchunguzi unaoendelea unaohitajika kumfahamisha mgonjwa kwamba kwa hakika hana saratani.

Mfano wa kipimo kibaya, kwa mtazamo huu, ni CEA-125. CEA-125 ni kemikali inayozalishwa na baadhi ya aina za saratani. Onkolojisti hutumia kiwango hiki kufuatilia majibu ya mgonjwa kwa chemotherapy.

Itakuwa na mantiki kutumia hii kama kipimo cha uchunguzi kwa saratani hizi, lakini haifanyi kazi. Watu wengi wana viwango vya juu vya CEA hata kama hawana saratani na kwa upande mwingine, saratani nyingi za GI (gastrointestinal) hazizalishi kemikali hii kabisa. Kupima watu wengi kwa vipimo vya CEA-125 kutaongoza kwa skani na biopsies zaidi, lakini shaka kama itakuwa na athari kubwa kwa viwango vya vifo kutokana na saratani.

Jambo jingine linaweza kuwa kuhusu saratani yenyewe. Ili kipimo kiwe cha msaada, saratani inahitaji kuwa na maendeleo marefu kupitia hatua za kabla ya saratani hadi hatimaye inapotokea saratani kamili.

Mfano ni saratani ya kolon. Watu wengi wanaopata saratani ya kolon wana polyps za kabla ya saratani miaka kadhaa kabla ya kupata saratani. Hii ndiyo sababu colonoscopies zinaweza kuwa na ufanisi katika kuzuia maendeleo hadi saratani ya kolon.

Kama mgonjwa atakuwa na colonoscopy, daktari anaweza kugundua uwepo wa polyps. Zaidi ya hapo, anaweza kuondoa polyps kupitia scope, akitarajia kuzuia maendeleo hadi saratani.

Nukta moja ya mwisho, inayohusiana, ni kwamba lazima kuwe na faida ya kugundua mapema saratani. Ikiwa kipimo kipya kinaweza kugundua saratani miezi sita mapema kuliko vipimo vilivyopo, watu wataishi kwa wastani miezi sita zaidi na saratani kuliko hapo awali, hata kama hakuna kitu kingine kinabadilika.

Swali ni kama utambuzi wa saratani mapema unaleta tiba bora zaidi. Je, unaweza kuiondoa kabla haijasambaa kwa tezi za limfu na hivyo kuepuka kabisa hitaji la chemotherapy?

Ikiwa matibabu na viwango vya majibu ni vivyo hivyo bila kujali hatua ya ugunduo wa saratani, basi uchunguzi hauwezi kuwa na mantiki.

Timu ya Kujitolea ya Kitaifa ya Marekani ya Huduma za Kuzuia (United States Preventive Services Task Force) ni jopo la wataalam wanaojitolea ambao wamepitia fasihi kuhusu vipimo mbalimbali. Kwa kuzingatia tafiti zilizofanywa kuhusu vipimo vinavyopatikana, wanatoa mapendekezo kuhusu vipimo mbalimbali na mara ngapi vinapaswa kutumika.

Jopo hili lina mtazamo wa tahadhari zaidi katika mapendekezo yao kuliko mashirika mengi ya kansa. Kwa mfano, wanapendekeza kila baada ya mwaka mmoja mmoja kwa matumizi ya mammograms kwa wanawake kati ya miaka 50 na 75, ikilinganishwa na uchunguzi wakilendelea kila mwaka unaopendekezwa na makundi mengine.

Kila pendekezo wanapounga mkono wanatoa alama ya jinsi tafiti zilivyo bora ambazo zinaunga mkono pendekezo hilo maalum, pamoja na viungo kwa tafiti hizo. Mapendekezo yao yamefanyiwa utafiti mzuri. Hii ni msaada kwa watu walio na hatari ndogo kuamua ni vipimo gani vya kufanya. Ikiwa mtu ana hatari kubwa kwa sababu ya historia ya familia au mfiduo, mapendekezo yao hayasaidii sana.

Changamoto za Saratani

Watu mara nyingi wanajadili saratani kana kwamba ni kitu kimoja. Kama ilivyo sema awali, saratani si kitu kimoja. Saratani ya ngozi inatenda tofauti na lymphoma, ambayo pia inatenda tofauti na sarcomas. Nafasi kwamba kutakuwepo tiba moja kwa ajili ya saratani zote—“Tiba ya Saratani” ambayo watu huzungumza juu yake, haionekani;

Changamoto kubwa zaidi wanapokabiliana na seli za saratani ni kwamba zinafanana sana na seli zetu za kawaida. Kimsingi, tunajaribu kuchoma sumu seli za saratani kidogo zaidi kuliko tishu zetu za kawaida. Kuna aina kadhaa za tiba zinazopatikana sasa. Katika Sehemu ya 2, tutaangazia baadhi ya chaguzi tofauti zinazopatikana leo na nyingine ambazo huenda zikapatikana siku za usoni.

Fikra za Mwisho

Kuna mambo machache yanayokuja akilini tunapofikiria juu ya mada ya saratani.

Hatuhitaji kuishi kwa hofu au kufanya maamuzi kwa hofu. Usiogope; kwa kuwa mimi nipo pamoja na wewe: usiteseke; kwa kuwa mimi ni Mungu wako: nitakujiimarisha; nitakusaidia; naam, nitakuunga mkono kwa mkono wa kuume wa haki yangu –Isaya 41:10.

Sidhani kwamba tunapaswa kukubali kwa kubahatisha chochote kitokee kwa sababu tu ni “mapenzi ya Mungu.” Tunahitaji kufanya maamuzi ya busara, kisha baada ya kufanya hivyo, hatupaswi kuishi katika hali ya wasiwasi.

Kwa hivyo msijali mno, mkiulizana, Tutakula nini? au Tutakayonywa nini? au tutavali vipi? (Kwa maana yote haya mataifa ya dunia yanafutilia): kwa kuwa Baba yenu wa mbinguni anajua kuwa mnahitaji yote haya. Bali yafuateni kwanza ufalme wa Mungu na haki yake; nao mambo yote hayo yatatolewa kwa nyinyi. Basi msijali kwa ajili ya kesho: maana kesho itajali kwa ajili yake mwenyewe. Kila siku maovu yake yanatosha –Mathayo 6:31-34.

Mwisho, ikiwa tunaweza, kupitia maamuzi ya busara, kuzuia saratani fulani kuunda au kusambaa, hilo linaonekana kuwa lengo lenye busara. Hakuna wetu ambaye ataishi milele katika mwili huu, lakini ikiwa tunaweza kufa kwa kitu kingine badala ya saratani, hilo linaonekana kuwa lengo zuri pia. Mungu atupatie hekima kutunza mwili aliotupa.
